Chaining: vignette structure — the tale jumps between porch and acted
covers; the character refs are the continuity carriers (Eli's porch for
every sung take, the Drifter's lock for every cover). Wide-action covers
(S01/S02/S03/S10/S23) fire text-first so the ref's standing pose cannot
lock the opening composition; all other takes fire image-first. Never
chain from a rejected take. Per-scene refs are named in work/scenes.json
companion notes in each vehicle file.
